mapper.sql: pay20_item_id AS item_id, pay20_item_type AS item_type, pay20_item_cd AS item_cd, pay20_item_nm AS item_name, pay20_non_tax_type AS non_tax_type, pay20_seq AS seq, pay20_use_yn AS use_yn, pay20_note AS note, f_cdnm('PayItemType', pay20_item_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS item_type_name, f_cdnm('NonTaxType', pay20_non_tax_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS non_tax_type_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pay20_item WHERE UPPER(pay20_item_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay20_item (pay20_item_id, pay20_item_type, pay20_item_cd, pay20_item_nm, pay20_non_tax_type, pay20_seq, pay20_use_yn) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{req.itemType}, #{req.itemCd}, #{req.itemName}, #{req.nonTaxType}, #{req.seq}, #{req.useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE pay20_item SET pay20_item_type = #{req.itemType}, pay20_item_cd = #{req.itemCd}, pay20_item_nm = #{req.itemName}, pay20_non_tax_type = #{req.nonTaxType}, pay20_seq = #{req.seq}, pay20_use_yn = #{req.useYn} WHERE pay20_item_id = #{req.itemId}
